description: This file contains extension methods for grains in the Orleans framework, specifically for constructing stream identities for implicitly subscribed streams.

classes.name: ImplicitConsumerGrainExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for grains to obtain implicit stream identities.

methods.name: GetImplicitStreamIdentity
methods.description: Constructs and returns a StreamIdentity object representing the stream that an implicitly subscribed grain is associated with.
